title: Remove source-text and source-shape tests across Engram and TermAl
outcome: Remove source-text and source-shape tests across Engram and TermAl
acceptance: Both projects carry the portable rule that no test passes or fails on source text or shape, including line or byte counts, file/function/module counts, required phrases, module layout or grep-style source scans, instead of observable behavior; source_id input identity is explicitly unaffected
Engram's inventory of existing source-text and source-shape tests is removed without mechanical code splits or replacement static gates
TermAl's inventory has a named owner in its own tracker and its source-text and source-shape tests are removed without mechanical code splits or replacement static gates
The wider inventory remains separate from the R25 sync landing and does not block it
